title: india_lp Policy Timeline Event Record
description: A single dated (or date-ranged) event in India's curriculum-policy or curriculum-licensing history -- past, current, or planned/future. Identical shape to deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's policy-timeline-event.schema.json, including the same accessTier/licenseOrRightsNote fields added 2026-09-30 (see the sibling repos' schema files, same date) -- India's founding session needed them from day one, since several of this repo's own founding events are directly about licensing/copyright status, not curriculum content itself.

eventType.description: Same core vocabulary as deutsche_lp's eventType, plus 'licensing-policy-change' -- added because this repo's founding content includes real, dated events that are specifically about a body's copyright/redistribution terms changing (e.g. a state textbook board revising its licensing-fee schedule), which is not itself a curriculum revision and shouldn't be filed as one.

dateGranularity.description: India's academic year generally runs April-March (unlike Germany's August-start or NY's September-start Schuljahr); record dateStart as the academic year's start where only a year is known, and note the granularity here.

temporalStatus.description: Relative to this record's own provenance.date -- not auto-derived, since 'current' drifts.

partOf.description: Id of a broader event/programme this is one milestone of, if any.

supersedes.description: Id of the prior curriculum-revision event this one directly replaces, if any -- lets a chain of a given jurisdiction/subject's curriculum editions (e.g. KCF 2007 -> KCF 2023) be walked in order without re-deriving it from prose each time. Distinct from partOf (a milestone WITHIN a broader programme): supersedes is specifically for one edition of the same curriculum replacing an earlier edition. Ported from deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's identical field (added there 2026-10-02 for Thuringia Biologie's multi-decade edition history) on 2026-10-09, for KCF 2007 -> KCF 2023 -- india_lp's schema predated that addition and had not needed it until now.

accessTier.description: How much of the underlying source this record actually keeps, chosen per-source based on what's legally safe to redistribute for this document -- not one all-or-nothing repo-wide rule. Same four values as deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's identical field. Given this repo's founding session found India's redistribution-rights picture to be genuinely unresolved for NCERT/CBSE curriculum text (see docs/source-notes/2026-09-30-india-curriculum-licensing-landscape-research.md), every founding-session event in this repo is deliberately kept at 'citation-only' regardless of how much text was actually available in the source read -- not because a higher tier is known to be unsafe, but because it has not yet been confirmed safe. Raise a record's tier only after the real legal review this repo's docs/strategy/2026-09-30-india-legal-review-scope.md calls for, or after direct confirmation of an explicit open license (e.g. Karnataka KOER's CC BY-SA 4.0, which is a real, checkable, already-confirmed license -- see that state's own records).

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal basis for storing this source at the accessTier chosen above. Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency.
